experiment: P7a static equal-MAC generic-convolution control for heterogeneous routing
question: Can the historical full-12 gain of MLCNN plus IQ-Grouped routing survive against a non-grouped raw-I/Q parameter branch with matched parameters and Conv/Linear MACs?
single_changed_axis: Add only a generic non-grouped raw-I/Q parameter branch to the shared MLCNN-global control; the heterogeneous candidate is unchanged.

static_only.control_family: MLCNN classification path plus raw-I/Q Conv1d branch [2,C, C,64,32,64] with kernels [15,9,7,5,3] and strides [4,1,2,2,2]
static_only.selection_rule: Select the grid value minimizing absolute MAC ratio error, subject to control/reference MAC ratio in [0.98,1.02] and trainable-parameter ratio in [0.98,1.02]. Tie-break lower channel count. If no candidate passes, do not generate data or train.
static_only.mac_definition: Conv1d and Linear multiply-accumulates measured by forward hooks; FLOPs are reported as two times MACs.

decision_rule: Only a passing static control is eligible for a separate P7a development preregistration on new identities. The selected channel value may not be changed after that preregistration is frozen.
